title: Local implement 'balanced' tier still routes to the codex CLI, off pi-durable
body:
.tick/runners.toml's [roles.implement.tiers.balanced] names kind = "codex" in the common file, so a local run (herdr or harness substrate) that explicitly pins --tier balanced dispatches an implement worker on the codex CLI — a worker harness that is neither pi-durable nor the claude-CLI frontier exception A1 allows. The local ladder never derives it (strong -> frontier only, runners.local.toml) and the cloud excludes it (runners.cloud.toml: 'balanced is not a rung'), so it is reachable only by explicit pin, but it survives jhp's deletion and a reviewer scoring A1 strictly will find it. Its fate belongs with jhp or an operator routing change; the file is the operator's, not this tick's to edit.
evidence: .tick/runners.toml, [roles.implement.tiers.balanced] (kind = "codex", model = "gpt-5.6-luna")
